zh: 元素互不相同时，数组复原等价于位置置换回到恒等；把排列拆成若干个不相交的循环来看。
长度为 L 的循环恰好在 L 的倍数次操作后复原，所以全部复原的最小正次数是所有循环长度的最小公倍数。
用 visited 数组沿 p 走出每个循环并记长度；LCM 可能非常大，不能直接用 64 位相乘，要把每个长度分解质因数，记录每个质数出现的最高次幂，最后把这些幂相乘取模 1,000,000,007。
en: With distinct elements, restoring the array is the same as the position permutation returning to the identity; look at the permutation as disjoint cycles.

A cycle of length L returns to its start exactly after a multiple of L operations, so the smallest positive number of operations restoring everything is the least common multiple of all cycle lengths.

Walk each cycle along p with a visited array and record its length; the LCM can be huge, so do not multiply it directly in 64 bits: factor each length, keep the highest power of each prime, and multiply those powers modulo 1,000,000,007.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Decompose the permutation into disjoint cycles. A cycle of length L needs a multiple of L operations to return to its original state, and the overall period is the least common multiple of the cycle lengths.

## Correctness

Because the array's elements are distinct, the array is restored after the operations if and only if the position permutation returns to the identity. A permutation cycle of length L first returns to its start after exactly L operations, so the moment everything is restored must be, and only needs to be, a common multiple of all cycle lengths; the smallest positive such moment is their least common multiple.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n + the cost of big-integer arithmetic), space O(n).
